craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Auspice that performs itself: of-own-will we sing — the verse does what it says; svecchayā agency held open per BOUNDARY (read as his). Rejected: (a) praise for sing → killed: stumaḥ performs; praise would describe. (b) resolving his/our will → killed by BOUNDARY held-open. Read aloud: WITH-re-LA-tion WHOSE-self IS-diff-er-ence-AND-non-DIFF-er-ence … HIM, ŚI-va, OF-own-WILL we-SING.

lines: With relation whose self is difference-and-non-difference, proving all things —
whose work is world-traffic — him, Śiva, of own will we sing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhedābhedātmasaṃbandhasahasarvārthasādhitā lokayātrā kṛtiryasya svecchayā taṃ stumaḥ śivam

reads_against.argmap: Under what auspice does the inquiry into relation open? → Auspice: the Lord whose will works world-traffic proves all things with difference-and-non-difference-relation.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
